Occurrences.Kwic: 四照用師一日示眾云。我有時先照後用。有時先用後照。有時照用同時。有時照用不同時。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Compiler narration by Huiyan Zhizhao in Eyes of Humans and Devas (人天眼目) supplies the Four Illumination-and-Function heading and definition in the Linji-house section; Linji Yixuan is the contextual master, not a quoted speaker of this clause.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: The headword and definition occur in compiler exposition under the Linji-house heading, without a live speech marker assigning the clause to a participant.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex f001 lane A semantic rereview repair

Occurrences.Kwic: 三玄、三要、四料揀、四賓主、四照用，已是臨濟老人吐下底殘羹餿飯。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Wanru Tongwei, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wanru (萬如禪師語錄), lists the Four Modes of Illumination and Function among Linji's numbered devices and calls them leftover food.

Occurrences.Kwic: 頌四照用曰：有時先照後用，舉似諸方傳誦，拋出無孔鐵鎚，莫怪山僧手重。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Layman Cheng Zhengkui, style Duanbo, in the Complete Collection of the Five Lamps, fascicles 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), gives a verse explicitly headed on the Four Modes of Illumination and Function; the governing source heading identifies him as the Grand Minister Cheng Zhengkui, style Duanbo.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四照用。照時劈箭，好醜俱現。纖芥不藏，日面月面。手握金輪，用處無情。三頭六臂，落膽喪魂。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Shanduo Zhenzai, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shanduo Zhenzai (山鐸真在禪師語錄), gives a new verse under the exact Four Modes label.

SearchAliases: Four Modes of Illumination and Function
Senses.Explanation: The four illumination-and-function combinations are illumination before function, function before illumination, both at once, and neither at the same time; later records redeploy the fourfold definition in interviews and verse. The selected exact turns and their attributed speakers or narrators bound this account; the entry does not add a resolution beyond those deployments.
